3.title: The Brightness Falls (episode)
3.source: Paraphrased from the Wikipedia article on Code Geass: Akito the Exiled (the Fandom page has no plot section)
paragraphs: The [[W-0]] Unit is refused permission to return to headquarters and is taken in for a time by a group of elderly Romani. [[Akito Hyuga]] and [[Leila Malcal]] bond with them and share what happened to them as children, which explains how they came to be where they are now.
Elsewhere, [[Julius Kingsley]] is revealed to be a brainwashed, darker version of [[Lelouch vi Britannia]]; he exerts his control while several leaders watch with a mix of awe and revulsion.

4.title: Memories of Hatred (episode)
4.source: Paraphrased from the Wikipedia article on Code Geass: Akito the Exiled (the Fandom page has no plot text)
paragraphs: While the [[W-0]] Unit is away, [[Leila Malcal]] and the crew left at the base are surrounded by Britannian Knightmares, and a spy among the crew is about to expose himself.
[[Shin Hyuga Shaing]] leads the enemy assault in the [[Vercingetorix]] after becoming Grand Master of the [[Holy Order of Michael]].
With no good option, Leila agrees to meet Shin in order to protect her squad. When the talks begin to collapse, [[Akito Hyuga]] returns with an unexpected ally and turns the situation around.
